tasks.title: T170 hourly clock-tower chime - small clocktower whose bell chimes on the real hour (cue + ripple ring), clock face shows the guild's REAL session uptime
tasks.seeded_by: orchestrator (bench quest per guild protocol: one real quest before assigning a workstream)
tasks.verify_cmd: cd /opt/data/missingno-worker && cp tasks_out/worker_clocktower.js /opt/data/cache/scratch/worker_clocktower_check.mjs && node --check /opt/data/cache/scratch/worker_clocktower_check.mjs && grep -qi 'window.GuildClocktower' tasks_out/worker_clocktower.js && head -1 tasks_out/worker_clocktower.js | grep -qvE '^[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*$' && echo VERIFY-OK
tasks.spec:
Create a NEW ES-module for the existing 2D guild client. The proven pattern is tasks_out/worker_visitor.js (injected via include_files) - copy its conventions: self-installing ES module, no imports, no top-level DOM access (typeof guards), state object on a window global, update(now)/draw(ctx) hooks attached to it, plus __probe for testing. The client render loop auto-discovers your window.Guild* global and calls update/draw every frame when V.gameState === 'play'.

Client contract (all on window): V (V.gameState, V.workers, V.workerStates, V.weather, V.daylight 0..1, V.growthStep, V.canvas, V.camera, V.grid {originX,originY,tileW,tileH}, V.allTasks array), iso(gx, gy) -> {x,y} world coords, fitText(text, maxW), window.GuildVisitor {gx, gy, moving, facing}, window.cue(name) optional sound hook (try/catch).

ZONE RULE: this prop must claim its named zone anchor and stand 2+ tiles offset from every existing prop there. No new accent colors - existing palette only (gold #d4af37, greens, blues, stone greys). Pure FX/prop layer, no collision, never writes to V or worker positions. Zero exceptions if V or iso are absent.

OUTPUT: only the new file, wrapped in one standard fenced code block (three backticks, no language tag). One line of prose max outside the fence.

BEHAVIOR - window.GuildClocktower = { chimes: [] } with update/draw/__probe (probe returns { chimes: chimes.length, faceTime }):
1. CLOCKTOWER: one small stone clocktower prop on the NW plaza rim (tiles around gx 1..3, gy 1..3, clamped within the grown floor, 2+ tiles from the quest board and museum): a stone-grey tower about 2 tiles tall with a gold #d4af37 clock face on its side and a tiny bell on top.
2. REAL-HOUR CHIME: when the REAL wall clock crosses an hour boundary (Date: minutes and seconds both wrap to ~0), the bell chimes once: a soft gold ripple ring expands from the tower (2-3 rings, fading alpha), plus window.cue('chime') in a try/catch. At most one chime per hour boundary; track the last chimed hour in state.
3. UPTIME FACE: the clock face hands show the guild's REAL session uptime (time since the module first loaded), not wall time - the island keeps time like a repo. Draw hour/minute hands from the uptime in HH:MM.
4. NIGHT GLOW: when V.daylight < 0.3 the clock face emits a soft warm gold halo (radial glow, alpha pulsing slowly); by day a small white glint. RAIN: halo dims. Zero exceptions.
